name: Shree Ganesh Biotech India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Shree Ganesh Biotech Ltd is in the trading of seeds and bhushi
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company does business of production, processing and marketing of high quality hybrid seeds for different crops like corn, sunflower, cotton, paddy, grain sorghum, etc., micronutrients, bio products, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.39 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.57% over last 3 years.
